metadata.note: Progress update on the week of 2026-10-26 — the second of the week's two videos. Toolkit-only patterns (ClaudeComposerAsk, ReelExecSummary, ReelFramework, BlipLadder, ClaudeVerdictArtifact, ClaudeTitleOutro). 16:9 only — weekly progress updates ship in landscape alone; the week's explainer carries the 9:16 cut. Every figure comes from this week's explainer build (measured audio, clip check, GATE V) or the paper it teaches.

beats.narration: What I learned: sparse attention is two costs, not one. The expensive pass got thirty-two times cheaper. The indexer still touches every pair. Still open: two patterns with no vertical twin.
